title: Kinetic Typography Hero
description: A monumental typographic composition with word-by-word entrance timing, sharp print contrast, and optional scroll registration.
installation: Copy component.tsx and useReducedMotion.ts into your project, then import styles.css once. React 18 or 19 is required.
reducedMotion: Word entrance animations are effectively immediate, scroll listeners and scroll-derived transforms are disabled, and the text layout remains unchanged.
